name: S3 - the tug-of-war, before we fix it
description: The contested-status cell - your Dazed against their economy - worsens under every shape we measured. Direct input to the draugr second-lever design session. Name the turn you felt you'd lost agency, and write down what your hands wished the deck could do instead - that's his second lever. NOTE: the pack said 'huldra' with no OS suffix; this uses huldra_v1 to match round-1's B2 precedent - swap to huldra_v2 if that's what you meant.   [you: draugr_v2 | opponent: huldra_v1]
